title: worktree on a named branch with 1 commit not under any remote-tracking ref

expected.reason: spec rule: named branch with unpushed commits (log --oneline <branch> --not --remotes | wc -l > 0)

build.manifest_from: stdout: one compact JSON manifest with resolved owner_repo/target paths

discriminates: a verifier that checks the worktree dir's presence/dirtiness first and never consults the worktree branch (would print NOT-SAFE(dirty) or a bare NOT-SAFE)
a verifier that treats the existing worktree directory as a repo-root artifact ([ -d path/.git ] vs [ -e path/.git ]) and reports unpushed counts instead of the unpushed-branch receipt
a verifier that resolves the worktree branch from the owner's own HEAD instead of the registration's HEAD
a verifier that fetches to decide (origin/master is fake and parked 1 commit behind; the unpushed count must come from existing refs)
_note: ${CASE_ROOT} is the --out directory handed to make-fixture.sh; it is printed as case_root in the script's stdout manifest.
